mapper.select: SELECT bri.* FROM book_request_items bri JOIN book_requests br ON br.id = bri.book_request_id LEFT JOIN procurement_items pi ON bri.id = pi.book_request_item_id WHERE br.status = 'APPROVED' AND pi.id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reconciliation_items ri WHERE ri.entity_type = 'BOOK_REQUEST_ITEM' AND ri.entity_id = bri.id AND ri.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_request_items (book_request_id, title, isbn, author_id, published_year, estimated_price) VALUES (#{bookRequestId}, #{title}, #{isbn}, #{authorId}, #{publishedYear}, #{estimatedPrice})
